player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
chara = player.Character

ch = chara:GetChildren()
for i = 1, #ch do
if ch[i].Name == "Torso" then
ch[i].roblox.Transparency = 1
elseif ch[i].Name == "Head" then

ch[i]:Destroy()
end
end

local Object = Instance.new(Object)

Object.Name = Name
return Object
